duration.text: The Chinese Language Program at Shanghai DianJi University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1111 USD/per semester ￥ 8000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1./Passport& Visa 2High school diploma (or equivalent, such as IB, A Level, etc.) and transcripts of all grades(semesters) of high school 3.Written in the teaching language ofthe applied program, including basic personal information, contact information, educational background (starting from senior high school), work or internship experience (if any), extracurricular activity participation, awards, hobbies, etc. The downtime between different experiences should not exceed 3 months. 4. PoliceClearance Certificate issued by local government or Character Certificate by the school with a recent date. 5.Financial Supporting Materials (Deposit Certificate, Bank Account balance details, etc) 6.Otherdocuments if applicable (other certificates, letters of recommendation, transfer letter, working certificate, etc .

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with good physical and mental health; 2. Age Range ofApplicants: over 18 years old 3. Education background: High school graduate or equivalent 4. Capable of affording the necessary expenditure 5. No criminal record
